entities.name: Fonn Zunich
entities.description: Half-elf Selesnya ledev guardian, daughter of wojek officer Myczil Zunich, later wife of Jarad.

entities.name: Biracazir
entities.description: Wolf mount of Fonn whose lifeforce reinvigorated Mat'Selesnya.

entities.name: Savra
entities.description: Devkarin priestess who planned to assassinate Bayul and tore off Fonn's hand.

entities.name: Jarad
entities.description: Golgari guildmaster and Savra's brother; Fonn's husband.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: Villain who brought Mat'Selesnya low and defeated by Jarad.

entities.name: Mat'Selesnya
entities.description: The Selesnya guildmaster reinvigorated by Biracazir.

entities.name: Izolda
entities.description: Cult of Rakdos member who targeted Myc.

entities.name: Decamillennial
entities.description: Celebration and disaster in which Fonn was involved.

events.summary: Jarad saves Fonn from Savra's assassination plot against Bayul.
events.quote: Fonn was saved by the bounty hunter Jarad

events.summary: Fonn brings Bayul to the mortuary with Agrus Kos; Bayul gives her the communication gem.
events.quote: Bayul woke just long enough to give his instructions to Fonn

events.summary: Savra's quietmen abduct Fonn and Savra rips off her hand when she refuses to give up the gem.
events.quote: the matka ripped her whole hand off.

events.summary: Szadek is defeated thanks to Jarad and Mat'Selesnya reinvigorated by Biracazir's lifeforce.
events.quote: Szadek was defeated thanks to Jarad

events.summary: Fonn learns the truth about her father's death from Kos.
events.quote: She learned that truth from Kos after the Decamillennial disaster

events.summary: Fonn and Jarad marry and have a son.
events.quote: The pair married, and stayed together for some time

events.summary: Rakdos cultists waylay Fonn's training group; Jarad and Fonn accidentally bind Myc's mind to the demon.
events.quote: accidentally binding Myc's mind with the demon 's.

events.summary: Jarad sacrifices his life to free Myc.
events.quote: Jarad sacrificed his life to free Myc.

events.summary: Myc leaves his mother to learn the ways of the Golgari.
events.quote: Myc decided to leave his mother

relations.quote: a romance kindled between Jarad and the half-elf
even having a son, Myczil Savod Zunich
